collisions.conflict: F is the effect (detector) operator in the script (vl06.tex Postulat 3 and 4) and the Helmholtz free energy in thermodynamics. BRIEF.md P3/P4 write E for the effect, which would collide with energy eigenvalues E_n and with Plavala's E(K).
collisions.proposal: Keep F for the effect operator in Parts I-III and F for the free energy in Parts IV-V as two semantic macros (\EffOp, \Fhelm) with disjoint chapter scopes recorded in the registry; if a chapter needs both, the free energy takes the IUPAC letter A there.
collisions.reason: Both letters are the ones a Lehramt student meets at school and that the existing script uses (vl06.tex); E for effects would collide in every chapter that has an energy.
collisions.provisional: none; no smoke chapter needs the quantum effect operator or the free energy (C2 uses Plavala's lower-case f as a bound variable).

collisions.conflict: U is a unitary (U_t, U_π, the coordinate change of Reed-Simon III p. 55) and the internal energy. vl16.tex:35 also uses U_ℓ(r) for the effective radial potential.
collisions.proposal: U stays the unitary in Parts I-III; internal energy is U only in Parts IV-V (scoped), and the effective radial potential becomes V_eff,ℓ.
collisions.reason: The effective potential is the only one of the three that shares a chapter (C11) with a unitary, and it is the only one without a fixed school letter.
collisions.provisional: sym.unitary is blessed-provisional (needed for the coordinate change in C11).

collisions.conflict: H is the Hamiltonian, \mathcal{H} the Hilbert space, H the enthalpy and H^2 the Sobolev space.
collisions.proposal: Hamiltonian H, Hilbert space \mathcal{H} (different glyphs, as in the script and in Plavala), enthalpy H_enth, Sobolev space always with its exponent and argument H^2(ℝ^3).
collisions.reason: The Hamiltonian appears in Parts IV-V next to the enthalpy, so scoping by chapter cannot separate them; the enthalpy is the rarer symbol.

collisions.conflict: S is the entropy, the spin operator, the symmetric group S_N and Plavala's simplex S_n (and his S(E)).
collisions.proposal: S is reserved for entropy (S_vN dimensionless, S thermodynamic); the simplex is Δ_n; spin carries a hat and an index (Ŝ_j) if hats survive, otherwise spin becomes s for the quantum number and the operators need a decision; the symmetric group is written Sym(N).
collisions.reason: Entropy is the meaning that cannot be renamed in a thermodynamics course.
collisions.provisional: sym.simplex is blessed-provisional as Δ_n (needed in C2).

collisions.conflict: Ω is the Fock vacuum (Bratteli-Robinson, per the pre-inventory, unverified) and the legacy macro \Om is the microcanonical state count; vl20.tex writes N_E for the count according to the pre-inventory.
collisions.proposal: Ω is the vacuum; the count is N_E; the legacy macro \Om is retired in the new course.
collisions.reason: The script itself already writes N_E, so only an unused macro changes.
collisions.provisional: none; no smoke chapter needs either.

collisions.conflict: Δ is the Laplacian (script \lap, Reed-Simon), the standard deviation Δx (vl09.tex:41-43), the energy-shell width (vl20.tex, per the pre-inventory) and, if the simplex is renamed, Δ_n. Reed-Simon also subscript the Laplacian (Δ_1, Δ_R).
collisions.proposal: Δ is the Laplacian, with a coordinate subscript where needed; Δ_n with an integer subscript is the simplex and appears only in Part I before any Laplacian; the standard deviation is written as the square root of the variance, with no symbol of its own; the shell width is δE.
collisions.reason: The Laplacian is fixed by every source; a separate standard-deviation symbol is not needed once Var is registered.
collisions.provisional: sym.laplacian and sym.simplex are both blessed-provisional; their tokens differ (Δ and Δ_n).

collisions.conflict: μ is the reduced mass (vl16.tex:29; PLAN.md 1.3 writes a_mu) and the chemical potential. Reed-Simon III p. 55 use μ_1, μ_2 for the two masses.
collisions.proposal: Two semantic macros (\massRed, \chempot) that both render μ, with disjoint chapter scopes (C11 against C17-C21) recorded in the registry. Fallback if TJO wants one glyph per meaning: reduced mass m_red and a_red, as the pre-inventory proposed.
collisions.reason: Both are the universal letters in their field, the chapters do not overlap, and PLAN.md 1.3 already writes a_mu.
collisions.provisional: sym.reduced-mass is blessed-provisional as μ (needed in C11).

collisions.conflict: p is a probability weight (vl01.tex:108), the momentum and the pressure. Probability weights and pressure meet in Parts IV-V.
collisions.proposal: p is the probability weight; the momentum operator always carries its hat (p̂), or is P if hats are dropped; pressure is capital P in Parts IV-V.
collisions.reason: Probabilities run through the whole course, so they keep the bare letter; pressure and Boltzmann weights share chapters and cannot share a letter.

collisions.conflict: V is the potential (vl16.tex:22, Reed-Simon III p. 55), the volume, and Plavala's ambient vector space V.
collisions.proposal: V is the potential in Parts I-III and the volume in Parts IV-V (two semantic macros, disjoint scopes); an external potential in Parts IV-V is written V_ext; Plavala's vector space is a source-scoped token in the translation guide only.
collisions.reason: Both are school letters; they meet only where a gas sits in an external potential.

collisions.conflict: K is Plavala's state space and, per the pre-inventory, the complex conjugation in Wigner proofs.
collisions.proposal: K is the state space; the antiunitary conjugation is written J.
collisions.reason: K is fixed by the source that C2 follows; the conjugation appears in one proof in C8 and no source for its letter is on disk.
